title: What is Digital Risk Protection?
answer: Digital Risk Protection (DRP) is the practice of identifying, monitoring and neutralising threats to a company's digital profile before they cause financial or operational damage. Unlike traditional ORM, DRP is proactive, detecting signals early across all 5 elements: AI representation, search results, brand mentions, reviews and narrative tone.

title: How is Reputation House different from an ORM agency?
answer: Traditional ORM agencies react — they clean up damage after it's done. Reputation House is a proactive risk protection system: a proprietary platform (Risk Control Center), a dedicated expert team, and an independent research center, combined into one end-to-end infrastructure. We price risk in financial terms, not vanity metrics.

title: What does the Risk Control Center platform do?
answer: Risk Control Center is our proprietary SaaS platform that monitors all 5 elements of a company's digital profile in real time. It provides early warning alerts, periodic dynamics reports and on-demand analysis, all in a single dashboard. It's the engine behind all managed service tiers and is also available as a standalone product.

title: Does Reputation House guarantee content removal?
answer: No, and any agency that does is misleading you. We operate within GDPR and platform-specific policies. We reduce exposure, counter damaging signals and manage narrative, so harmful content loses visibility and impact. We're transparent about what's achievable and what isn't.

title: What happens in the first 24 hours of a reputation crisis?
answer: The first 24 hours determine whether a crisis becomes chronic. Our Defence team deploys immediately: 24/7 monitoring, rapid counter-narrative development, simultaneous activation across all relevant channels. We focus on containing the spread and quantifying financial exposure, not just managing communications.

title: How do I know if my company needs this?
answer: Start with a free Risk Check. In 3 minutes you'll see what banks, investors and AI assistants currently say about your company, and where the vulnerabilities are. No commitment, no login required.

title: Can I see reviews or testimonials from real Reputation House clients?
answer: Not by name — client confidentiality is the foundation of how we work, and we don't publish named testimonials or case studies with client identities attached. What you can check is independent Reputation House reviews on G2 and Clutch, left by verified users, alongside our track record of 25 international awards.
